summary: Created a 9-phase plan for the Route B full build: Simpson's labelled/bounded-context canonical model framework in Lean 4, targeting cs5_completeness (CS5 = IS5 constructive Kripke completeness). Built directly on report 01 (source-PDF-grounded, authoritative). The spine is Simpson Ch. 5-6 -- Prime Lemma 5.3.1 (Zorn over whole labelled contexts), Canonical Model Lemma 5.3.2 (box-backward via fresh label + box-intro), Theorem 6.2.1 (Hilbert<=>labelled adequacy, T subset {chi_D,chi_T,chi_B,chi_4,chi_5}, covering CS5's B and 5) -- NOT Ch. 7-8, which is the finite model property and explicitly excludes IS5. Reports 516/01 and 516/02 are superseded on chapter structure; the plan states that their 8.2.4/8.2.5/8.2.6 lemma references are wrong and must not be followed. The hardest node -- the tree internalization (Lemma 6.1.2/6.2.3), where Simpson is self-declaredly informal ('without too much formality') and OMITS the (bot-E)/(or-E) cases as 'quite intricate' -- is GATED as Phase 3 and dispatched first among the risk-bearing nodes, before the entire semantic spine, with both branches fully specified. Confidence recorded honestly at ~50% (45-55%) in the plan Overview with the hardest node named; deliberately not inflated. The plan encodes the key structural insight (Zorn-over-CONTEXTS IS the simultaneous maximal pair CS5.lean:700-710 named as missing; cross-world invariants become CONSEQUENCES of deductive closure under box-elim, not constraints threaded through the Zorn -- why Route B escapes task-512's wall), the full guardrail analysis with a standing constraint forbidding any phase from fixing the head in box-backward, the verified reuse and the confirmed non-reuse, the zero-debt invariant, and the corpus warning.

Every reused lemma carries its real name + file:line, re-verified at source. Guardrails encoded: cs5_symmetric_tail_box_gap's ARGUMENT transfers and is saved ONLY by its fixed-head hypothesis, so a standing constraint (repeated in Phase 6 and 7 verification criteria) forbids any phase from fixing the head or bounding the context in box-backward; cs5Incest_forces_symm APPLIES but is SATISFIED because B_K's R is primitive graph data satisfying T by construction and T-primeness's Consistency clause banishes Omega. Non-reuse: CKSegment/Segment/SegmentLindenbaum are excluded with grep-confirm checks -- their fixed-other-component shape IS the bug. The Section 8.1 soundness failure is documented as provably not touching the completeness direction.

gate.name: Adequacy bridge -- Lemma 6.2.2 + Lemma 6.1.2/6.2.3 tree internalization
gate.dispatch_order: first among risk-bearing nodes; before the entire semantic spine (Phases 5-8); parallel with Phase 4
gate.why_not_literally_phase_1: Its statement quantifies over |-_G, so the labelled syntax (Phase 1) and the N_IK(T) deduction system (Phase 2) are logical prerequisites that cannot be skipped. Phases 1-2 are therefore scoped as MINIMAL gate prerequisites -- land exactly what the gate needs, nothing speculative. Wave 3 is the earliest dispatchable point, and report 01's substantive requirement ('P8 is separable and should be dispatched early in parallel ... Do not leave P8 last') is met in full: the gate precedes the entire semantic spine.
gate.why_hardest: Simpson's proof is informal by his own admission (:6558 'we hope that this makes the proof comprehensible without too much formality') and OMITS the (bot-E) and (or-E) cases as 'quite intricate because their premises and conclusion may have prefixes arbitrarily far apart in G' (:6544). The treeness invariant (:6533) is never stated as a lemma. It is RECONSTRUCTION, not transcription, and it sits on the unavoidable Hilbert<=>labelled adequacy bridge.
gate.bounded_attempt: 2 agent dispatches; do not open a third
gate.mitigation: Define LCons G Gamma x A := Derivable CS5ModalAxiom ((Gamma |-_G x:A)*), making the bridge definitional at the trivial graph and converting Lemma 6.1.2 into per-rule admissibility obligations -- modular and incremental, so the gate verdict is evidence-based rather than a judgement call.
gate.on_success: Proceed through Waves 4-8; Phase 9 assembles cs5_completeness.
gate.on_failure: Land NOTHING under Cslib/ for the phase; move partial work to specs/517_.../probes/adequacy-gate-probe.lean and write specs/517_.../handoffs/adequacy-gate-blocker-handoff.md documenting which case resisted, the goal shape, what was tried, and whether the obstruction looks tedious or conceptually hard. Waves 4-8 still execute and land a reusable labelled framework + countermodel construction. Phase 9 unreachable; task -> [BLOCKED]. Never accrue a sorry.

notes_for_implementers: CORPUS WARNING: the Simpson literature corpus chunks are broken -- 1091 chunks, ~312 byte mean, key chunks 122-140 bytes containing truncated titles with '> ...' preview artefacts. They are UNUSABLE for lemma statements, and are exactly how report 516/02 mis-identified the spine as Chapter 8. Work from specs/517_.../reports/01_labelled-bounded-context-method.md or the source PDF (/home/benjamin/Downloads/Simpson_1994_IntuitionisticModalLogic.ocr.pdf, pdftotext -layout, 13488 lines -- report 01's line numbers refer to that extraction). NEVER take lemma statements from literature-search.sh chunk snippets. Task 518 re-ingests the document but is NOT a blocker, because report 01 already carries the verbatim-grounded statements.

STANDING GUARDRAIL CONSTRAINT: the box clause MUST retain its <=-quantification over larger contexts. No phase may fix the head or bound the context in the box-backward case -- doing so re-imposes exactly the hypothesis q not-in H that makes cs5_symmetric_tail_box_gap (CS5.lean:712) fatal, and re-enters task-512's wall. Repeated in the Phase 6 and Phase 7 verification criteria.
B_K's R' must be PRIMITIVE graph data (from R_w), never boxInv-derived. If R' ever becomes r Gamma Delta := boxInv Gamma subset Delta, the construction has regressed to task 512's and is wrong.

Do NOT reuse SegmentLindenbaum's engine (quasi_prime_exclusion:73, box_refuting_theory:177, dia_refuting_theory:203, quasi_head_realization:251) -- its fixed-other-component shape IS the bug that destabilised task 512 Phases 8-10. Do NOT generalize QuasiPrime (Segment.lean:64) -- it admits Omega = univ, and CK/CT/CS4's landed completeness needs fallible worlds.

Use Simpson's geometric theory {chi_T, chi_5} inside the construction, NOT Marin's klmn condition; cs5FCIncest is only DERIVED at the end, in Phase 8. (Report 01 notes that Simpson's Section 6.3 inexpressibility condition is violated by exactly the (1,1,0,0) instance CSLib transcribes as cs5Incest -- hence the ordering.)
Do not rework cs5FCIncest (task 512 Phase 4's landed definition) -- that requires explicit human authorization.

Phase 2's eigenvariable/freshness conditions are a known Lean cost centre; report 01 flags the line estimate could be off 2x. Prefer a locally-nameless encoding (precedent: CSLib Languages/Lambda). If Phase 2 exceeds ~600 lines, stop and re-plan rather than expanding in flight.
